تعتكدون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَكِدُونَ (taʕtakidūna) /taʕ.ta.ki.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# تُعْتَكَدُونَ (tuʕtakadūna) /tuʕ.ta.ka.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
